errors.text: The hypothesis predicts rapid dislocation multiplication at high temperature, whereas the target reports a significant reduction in dislocation density at 900–1200 K as rapid lattice disorder develops.
It fails to define the requested critical threshold of 900 K and instead gives only an ambiguous regime above 600 K.
The proposed screw-dislocation kink-pair mechanism is imported mainly from BCC refractory HEAs and is not established for the FCC FeNiCrCoCu coating.
It does not reconstruct the observed stacking-fault evolution, particularly the increasing HCP atom fraction and the shift from stacking-fault-mediated deformation to lattice disorder.
